role: Full Stack Developer · JavaScript / TypeScript · Node.js / Firebase

summary.heading: Professional Summary
summary.body: Full stack developer with 5+ years of experience in the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem, working across front-end (React, React Native, Next.js) and back-end (Node.js, Firebase, PHP, MySQL/PostgreSQL). Started by building complete full stack systems — including admin panels (backoffice) for managing users, content and data, very close to a CRM — before specializing in front-end on large-scale projects spanning government, health and mobility. Co-founder of a freelance software studio (A&A IT), and currently Full Stack Developer at MIGMA (Los Angeles, USA). Comfortable owning both the client and server sides of a product, in agile, remote teams.

bullets: Owning the full product cycle — front-end and back-end — within a distributed remote team.
Developing a ride-hailing mobile application for Go Marketing&Co. as a client of A&A IT, built with React Native and Expo. Scheduled for launch in 2026.

jobs.role: Senior Frontend Developer and Tech Lead — Capgemini
bullets: Led the front-end of a streaming platform for Portugal's Ministry of Health, collaborating daily with the back-end team on API integration and business rules.
Built applications with React, Next.js and TypeScript, with unit testing and quality standards (ESLint).
Also acted as UI/UX designer, prototyping in Figma from project conception.

jobs.role: Cofounder and Full Stack Engineer — A&A IT
bullets: Co-founded and operate a freelance software studio, delivering 3 production projects for 3 different clients using React and React Native.
Launched a service-request marketplace (live in production) built with React Native + Expo, connecting service providers and clients on iOS and Android.

Designed and developed a cloud storage system (similar to Google Drive) from Figma prototype to production, integrated with DigitalOcean infrastructure — owned end-to-end, from UX design to deployment.
Built government-scale systems (traffic fine enforcement and environmental monitoring) with React.js, Next.js and Redux, always alongside back-end teams.
Developed mobile and web features using Ionic, Angular, TypeScript and Firebase as the primary database.
Built the geolocation-based lost & found feature and a BMI calculator for the MEUPET app.
Contributed to the internal stats and bug-reporting dashboard — hands-on experience with Firebase in production.
Built complete systems (front and back-end) in PHP, JavaScript and MySQL for major brand campaigns, including coupon registration and automated giveaways.
Developed an admin panel (backoffice) for managing winners, prizes and alerts — a system very close to a campaign CRM.
Developed and maintained dynamic sites with a proprietary backoffice, letting clients manage content, banners and users independently — the base of a customer management system.
Worked across the full stack cycle: front-end (PHP, HTML, CSS, JS, Bootstrap), database (MySQL/phpMyAdmin) and deploy (FTP).
Full stack mobile and web development with Ionic, Angular, TypeScript, PHP and MySQL/PostgreSQL for a range of clients.
